senses.definition: simple past and past participle of have
examples: This morning I had an egg for breakfast.
A good time was had by all.

quotes.text: About thirty years ago, Miss Maria Ward, of Huntingdon, with only seven thousand pounds, had the good luck to captivate Sir Thomas Bertram, of Mansfield Park, in the county of Northampton,[…].

senses.definition: (auxiliary, followed by a past participle) Used to form the past perfect tense, expressing an action that took place prior to a reference point that is itself in the past.
examples: I felt sure that I had seen him before.
When I'd (already) done some exercise, I had a cappuccino.

senses.definition: (auxiliary, now rare) As past subjunctive: would have.
examples: Had I not known you were coming this evening, I'd have left at midday.
